tokens.name: wall
tokens.usage: The room: window chrome and toolbar background around the paper.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The one sheet: month or week grid and panel together, popovers, the settings modal.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: One step off the paper: weekend columns in the month and week grid, widget nest.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the spine between grid and panel, week rules, outlines of controls; fill of the primary button and of chosen items.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, weekday names, calendar names, empty states. On paper, wall and raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Out-of-month dates, placeholders and disabled controls only. Never for text people need to read.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the paper's edge on the wall, rules between days in lists, the floating shadow's colour in light.

tokens.name: shade-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of disabled fields and of a switched-on (toggled) control's neighbours; out-of-month cells have no ground, only faint numbers.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Ground of a ToDo chip in a memo.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and check marks on an ink fill.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Pointer over a day cell, list row or button: a quiet step off the paper.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The chosen item where one is picked from many: menu cursor, picked event, chosen segment. Text on it is on-ink.

tokens.name: row-active
tokens.usage: A row being edited or opened in place (a ToDo renamed, the row a menu belongs to). Ink text on it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2 pt paper gap, then a 2 pt ink ring around the control.

tokens.name: holiday
tokens.usage: Public-holiday and Sunday date numbers and holiday names. Holidays only.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions: the delete button's text and outline. Never a frame or background.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text: ink with a warning sign, so red stays with holidays and delete.

tokens.name: error-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an error or warning notice.

tokens.name: now
tokens.usage: The current-time line in the week grid and the day strip.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Source links on ToDos: ink, underlined.

tokens.name: widget-surface
tokens.usage: Desktop widget background (C · lights off): no outline, the radius does the framing.

tokens.name: widget-nest
tokens.usage: Inside a widget: the oval behind the date and other nested areas.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: User palette · 빨강: calendar mark, text colour, ToDo label. On paper and on any *-tint.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: User palette · 빨강: highlighter, all-day band and day-strip block background. Dark: 20% of the ink over graphite paper.

families.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Gowun Batang (OFL, bundled). Titles only: the month or week name, panel and modal headings, the widget date. Never numbers in the grid, emails or sentences.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Month or week title in the toolbar.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Popover titles: event detail, ToDo import, settings sub-sheets.

styles.name: big-date
styles.usage: Today's date on the small widget, inside the oval.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: SF Pro: everything people read and write, and every number in the grid.

styles.name: date
styles.usage: Date numbers in the month and week grid (today: bold).

styles.name: item
styles.usage: ToDos and events in the panel, list rows in popovers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Controls, menus, form fields, sentences in notices.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Text buttons, notices, helper lines under fields.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section names before a rule. No tracking: Hangul spreads apart.

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: Event titles inside day cells (보통). 작게 10 / 크게 13 via 설정 › 일반.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Times, calendar names, counts, weekday names.

spacing.note: 4 pt base with two half steps (2, 6) for tight rows. Every gap in the app is one of these.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Mark to text, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list; label to field.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Inside a row; between a section rule and its first row.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Control padding; between fields.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Popover padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Window margins; modal padding.

radius.note: Everything drawn is square; only widgets are round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Paper, cells, buttons, boxes, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-widget
tokens.usage: Desktop widgets (system mask).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Reminder rings, the now dot.

line.note: Crisp ink lines, never wobbly. One heavy line (the spine), everything else hairline.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Week rules, control outlines, popover outline, hairlines.

tokens.name: line-mark
tokens.usage: Outline of small marks and boxes under 14 pt.

tokens.name: line-box
tokens.usage: Checkbox outline, reminder ring, the now line.

tokens.name: line-spine
tokens.usage: The one heavy line: between grid and panel, under the weekday row, under a picked day.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Width of the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-gap
tokens.usage: Paper gap between a control and its focus ring.

shadow.note: Nothing on the main paper casts a shadow. Only what floats above it does: one hard offset, no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the settings modal.

motion.note: Short and plain. With Reduce Motion on, slides become fades.

tokens.name: motion-quick
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states.

tokens.name: motion-panel
tokens.usage: Panel show/hide, popovers.

opacity.note: The few see-through values; everything else is a solid token.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: Black over the whole window under the settings popup, and again under a confirmation inside it.

tokens.name: opacity-modal-shadow
tokens.usage: Black flat shadow of the settings popup and its confirmation over the dimmed window (light; dark uses black).

tokens.name: opacity-primary-hover
tokens.usage: The primary button under the pointer or pressed.

tokens.name: opacity-out-of-month
tokens.usage: Events in day cells of the next or last month.
